CheckResponse.description: One registration check and its outcome. NOT_RUN is shown, never hidden.

GeoJsonPolygon.description: GeoJSON Polygon with one closed ring of [longitude, latitude] points

boundary.description: Null until the plot is walked

documentAreaM2.description: Typed by the farmer from the document, not read from it

plantedArea.description: Null means the whole walked boundary counts as planted

plantingDate.description: Null only on seeded placeholder plots

financialActionsAllowed.description: True only at FIELD_VERIFIED or higher, with no open dispute

monitoring.description: Satellite state, latest image date and season flag. Details: GET /plots/{id}/monitoring

dataStatus.description: TO_CONFIRM marks a placeholder plot whose details are not real

isDemo.description: When true, every UI must show a Demo label

value.description: null means 'not supplied yet', never zero

sumInsured.description: From the insurer. Leave null until confirmed.

premium.description: From the insurer. Leave null until confirmed.

payoutRate.description: Share of the sum insured to pay, from the insurer's rate table (0 to 1)

triggerDate.description: The date the trigger rule was met

status.description: Always take it from the server, never from local data

payoutRate.description: Null until the insurer confirms the rates. Show 'not confirmed', never 0.

amount.description: Null until the insurer confirms the rates. Show 'not confirmed', never 0.

evidenceSnapshot.description: Frozen evidence from when the claim started. Only in GET /claims/{id}; null in the list.

decision.description: The latest officer decision, or null

isDemo.description: When true, show a Demo label

review.description: The farmer's latest review request, or null

canRequestReview.description: True when the farmer may ask for a review now (one per decision)

isSimulated.description: Always true: Rinda never moves real money

claimId.description: The open claim this report was attached to as evidence. A report never creates one.

photoUrl.description: Fetch with your token; null when there is no photo

reportedAt.description: When the farmer made the report on the phone

isDemo.description: When true, show a Demo label

upi.description: As typed from the farmer's own e-title

declarationAccepted.description: Must be true: the farmer confirms they have the right to farm this plot and that a false claim can cancel cover

WalkPoint.description: One GPS fix recorded by the app while the farmer walks the plot's edge

accuracyM.description: The fix's horizontal accuracy in metres, from the phone

mockLocation.description: True when Android reports the fix came from a mock-location app

points.description: In the order recorded. Don't repeat the first point at the end: the server closes the boundary.

typedAreaM2.description: Area typed by the farmer from the document, in m²

verified.description: True once the farmer confirmed the number with the code sent to it

nameMatch.description: Whether the account name matches the farmer's name

nameCheck.description: The name check is simulated: Rinda has no access to mobile-money accounts

message.description: What the farmer sees in the field

reason.description: Required for every decision; the farmer reads it

accessTokenExpiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires

checklist.description: The checklist as the agent ticked it

claimId.description: The plot's open claim this visit is evidence for

source.description: GEE (real satellite data, the default) or SAMPLE (simulated, demo plots only)

plotIds.description: Plots to analyse. For GEE, leave out to analyse every eligible real plot. Required for SAMPLE.

asOf.description: Last day of data to include. Defaults to today.

errorCode.description: Why it was skipped or failed

items.description: Per plot. Only in GET /admin/analysis-runs/{id}; null in the list.

dap.description: Days after planting. Null if the planting date is unknown.

dataOrigin.description: SAMPLE_FILE is simulated and must be labelled Demo

date.description: Null if the plot has not been analysed yet

rainPct.description: Rain over 30 days as a percent of normal. Null if unknown, never 0.

signals.description: What the status is based on. Each item has a code, and some have values.

dataOrigin.description: GEE, or SAMPLE_FILE for simulated data

lastKnownStatus.description: Only with NOT_ENOUGH_DATA: the newest real status, which is not current

lastKnownDate.description: The date of lastKnownStatus, for "Last update: <date>"

thresholdsUsed.description: The threshold values this result used

dap.description: Days after planting. Null if the planting date is unknown.

ndvi.description: Null when too few clear pixels were available. Show a gap.

dataOrigin.description: SAMPLE_FILE is simulated and must be labelled Demo

message.description: Plain-words text for the state, in English. Apps may use their own translated copy.

verificationNote.description: Null at FIELD_VERIFIED or higher; otherwise says the plot is not verified yet

healthStatusAvailable.description: Crop health and the claim trigger run only on FIELD_VERIFIED plots

dataOrigin.description: SAMPLE_FILE is simulated data, on demo plots only

latestImageDate.description: Date of the latest usable image. Always show it.

monitoredSince.description: Start of the fetched period (the planting date)

refreshing.description: A fetch is queued or running now

minClearPixels.description: Empty means no image counts as usable yet

ndviMedian.description: Median NDVI of the clear pixels

cloudFraction.description: Share of the plot's pixels masked as cloud, shadow or not clear

usable.description: False when the image has fewer clear pixels than min_clear_pixels

lowPct.description: Low end, as a percent of normal

highPct.description: High end, as a percent of normal

dataOrigin.description: GEE, or SAMPLE_FILE for simulated data

thresholdsUsed.description: The threshold values this result used

dapBin.description: First day of the bin, in days after planting

filled.description: True if estimated from the bins on each side. Show it differently.

dataOrigin.description: GEE, or SAMPLE_FILE for simulated data

awaitingDecision.description: Claims waiting for an officer: under review, field visit done or not, review requested

flaggedOpen.description: Open claims with at least one review flag

approvedUnpaid.description: Approved but not paid: rates or the farmer's payout account are missing

triggerValuesMissing.description: Trigger values not supplied yet; while any is missing, no claim can start

latestAnalysisRun.description: The latest analysis run, or null

daysOpen.description: Days since the claim started, while it is still open; null once closed

reviewFlags.description: What the officer should check, from the evidence snapshot

openReview.description: The farmer asked for a review that is not answered yet

cover.description: The cover the claim was made under, or null

payoutAccount.description: The farmer's payout account, or null when there is none

problemReports.description: Problem reports on the plot, newest first

fieldVisits.description: Field visits on the plot, newest first

history.description: Everything that happened to this claim, oldest first

answeredReview.description: True when this decision answered a review request

msisdnMasked.description: Only the last 3 digits are shown

type.description: HEALTH opens plot detail, CLAIM opens claim detail

code.description: Stable value to translate in the app, such as HEALTH_AT_RISK

title.description: English text. The app should show its own text for the code.

isDemo.description: When true, show a Demo label

isMock.description: True: invented demo data, not official land records. Always label it.

notice.description: Plain words to show with the result

boundary.description: The parcel's shape as the provider has it. Never the plot's boundary.

pendingVerificationCount.description: Plots waiting for this agent's check

atRiskCount.description: Plots whose newest crop health status is AT_RISK

openClaimsCount.description: Claims not yet paid or final

isDemo.description: When true, show a Demo label

code.description: Stable value that clients branch on

fields.description: Only with VALIDATION_FAILED: one message per field name
